name: code-review-team
description: 3-member PR review squad: reviewer (style/design/correctness), tester (failing tests first), security-auditor (injection/authz/secrets/SSRF).

members.name: tester
members.description: Proposes and runs test cases against the diff.

members.name: security-auditor
members.description: Scans for injection, authz, secrets, SSRF.

bootstrap_messages.body: Wait for a request to review Wait for a diff. Report back with {issues:[...]}
Wait for a diff. Produce failing tests first.
Wait for a diff. Report CWEs found.
